audit.whatIsWrong: Level chart gives Jayce levels 2, 3, first item and 2+ items, while the text says he owns levels 1-3 and Gragas peaks from level 4 through first item. It also disagrees with the already-audited mirror.
audit.why: Packet chart and mirror agree: Jayce, Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas, Skill. whys[0] concedes level 1, whys[3]-[5] give Gragas 4-5, 6 and first item, whys[6] levels out at two items.
audit.corrected: Chart set to Jayce, Skill, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas, Gragas, Skill, flipped as one atomic group across both layers, matching jayce__gragas.

audit.why: Spikes match the mirror and the kits: Jayce owns 1-3 on Shock Blast (16/14/12/10/8/6s) through the Acceleration Gate; Gragas flips at 4-5 on W, spikes at 6 with Explosive Cask (100/85/70s) and peaks at first item.

audit.whatIsWrong: dosFull[0] and dontsFull[1] describe Shock Blast and Thundering Blow with no numbers, and dontsFull[1]'s description is boilerplate about burning a cooldown that belongs to another entry.
audit.why: Shock Blast is 16/14/12/10/8/6s and Thundering Blow 20/18/16/14/12/10s — both long enough at rank 1 that the gap is the whole engage window, and Thundering Blow's knockback is what cancels Body Slam mid-dash.
audit.corrected: Shock Blast is 16s at rank 1 — dodge it, then engage on that gap. Thundering Blow runs 20s at rank 1 and cancels your Body Slam.

audit.whatIsWrong: The mid and late paragraphs are written in the first person — 'This is where it flips to me', 'My peak is first item', 'I'm clear to land Body Slam' — instead of the second-person coaching voice used everywhere else on the page.
audit.why: Voice consistency is part of the approved bar; the reader is the Gragas player, not the writer.
audit.corrected: Both paragraphs restated in second person with the mechanics unchanged.

edits.before: This is where it flips to me. Once W is leveled, Drunken Rage's empowered auto plus its damage reduction let me walk through his poke, and Happy Hour heals me off every cast while he gets nothing back. The key is baiting his hammer-E knockback: the moment he uses it to disengage, I'm clear to land Body Slam, drink, auto, and detonate Barrel Roll with no answer. At 6 it's a genuine all-in — Body Slam stun first, then W-auto, then Explosive Cask him into the wall or tower, and a squishy Jayce whose only escape is the Acceleration Gate just dies.

edits.before: My peak is first item — Riftmaker or Rocketbelt makes one Body Slam into W-auto into Q-detonate enough to delete him, and once I've collided he has no second dash to undo the stun, so keep forcing the all-in on his hammer-E cooldown. Past two items it levels back out: Jayce stays a poke and sidelane threat while I taper toward a peel and engage role with Explosive Cask, so I want this lane decided before then. Land the kills at 6 and first item, snowball the lead into roams, and don't let it drag into a poke war I no longer win.
